channels.G: part UV.v, linear UNORM8, bottom-left UV origin

color_space: linear data; no sRGB, gamma, ICC, tone mapping or premultiplied storage

sampling.atlas: nearest; no mipmaps; disable sRGB; clamp each frame
sampling.parts: bilinear; decode parts_preview RGB from sRGB to linear before lighting
sampling.brightness: multiply linear parts RGB by 2 * B; B=0.5 is neutral
sampling.antialiasing: supersample, dominant UV island, coverage alpha

render.color_management: Raw, exposure 0, gamma 1; float EXR intermediate

skin.description: Rounded head, nose and hands; cylindrical / spherical

helmet.description: Helmet dome and nasal guard; cylindrical

tunic.description: Coat and flared skirt; cylindrical, seam at +X

shield_face.description: Shield front; circular planar UV, centre (0.5, 0.5)

shield_rim.description: Thick shield rim; radial front mapping

metal.description: Helmet rim, shield boss and crossguard

blade.description: Blade; U across width, V from guard to tip
